storyOfTheMatch: Alaves — 6th place after 7 rounds, 11 points, goal difference 11-6. The team from Vitoria is fighting for European spots and cannot afford hesitation.

Atletico Madrid — 2nd place after 7 rounds, 16 points, goal difference 16-7. The Rojiblancos are in form, second only to the league leaders.

Chance for Alaves: Atletico comes away after focused matches; Mendizorroza can be a difficult ground if Boyé's team capitalizes on counter-attacks.
